links.outcome: AI landmark indication performance under intraoperative bleeding (perturbed input) in massive bleeding cases
links.effect: Baseline gAI performed poorly under massive bleeding: pancreas Dice 0.36 ± 0.26, rising to 0.65 ± 0.17 with GAN-based bleeding removal (P < 0.05).
links.quote: Dice coefficients for the pancreas increased from 0.36 ± 0.26 to 0.65 ± 0.17 (P < 0.05).

unlisted_practices: Integrating a CycleGAN generative model into the inference pipeline to remove bleeding and improve surgical navigation AI robustness

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an enhanced AI model (gAI with CycleGAN pre-processing/integration to remove intraoperative blood obscuration) using retrospective laparoscopic videos rated by expert surgeons. It evaluates algorithmic pipeline enhancements rather than an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
